verdict.rationale: Justworks has a native payment flow (Pay > Make a Payment) and docs refer to checking pay data in the Custom Payroll Report before running payroll, so a payroll run exists in the product. However, that review happens in a separate Analytics report, and nothing documents a single flow covering hours and earnings review, a totals preview, and submission. Missing for 10: documented in-flow review of hours and earnings, a pre-submit totals preview, an explicit submit/approve step, any proof the steps form one flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: If you see any inaccuracies, change this information directly in the Justworks before running payroll.
clicking on Pay in the side navigation menu > Make a Payment on the top right of the page > Domestic and scrolling down to Record a Payment.
